pending_qa.q: Who is Duane Keefe D Davis and why was he arrested for Tupac Shakur's murder?
pending_qa.r: Dwayne Keith Davis, also known as Keefe D, is the uncle of Orlando 'Baby Lane' Anderson, who is believed to be the trigger man in Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder. Davis was arrested in September 2023 at age 60 after investigators determined that statements he made in his memoir Compton Street Legend and in a BET interview amounted to a near-confession, in which he acknowledged being in the front seat of the car from which the fatal shots were fired.

pending_qa.q: Why did it take nearly 30 years to charge someone with Tupac Shakur's murder?
pending_qa.r: The case stalled partly because Orlando Anderson, the alleged shooter, died in an unrelated gang-related shooting a few years after Tupac's murder. Additionally, a 2009 proffer agreement between Davis and the LAPD protected him from prosecution in exchange for information. It was only when Davis publicly repeated his account in his memoir and in media interviews that prosecutors were able to use his own words against him.

pending_qa.q: What is the defense strategy for Dwayne Davis at the Tupac Shakur murder trial?
pending_qa.r: Davis's defense team argues that the case lacks physical evidence — no gun, no ballistics, and no DNA — which are the types of evidence juries typically look for. They also contend that Davis's statements in his book were embellishment and storytelling rather than a confession, and that the prosecution cannot rely on one without the other if they lack corroborating forensic evidence.

pending_qa.q: What is the latest development in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial?
pending_qa.r: The prosecution called medical professionals and psychiatrists to challenge the defense's claim that Clancy was suffering from postpartum psychosis. A doctor who treated Clancy in the ICU testified that when asked about her mood, she wrote 'horrified' on a whiteboard, and also asked 'Do I have an attorney?' — which prosecutors argued demonstrated she had the mental acumen to protect her own rights and understood that what she did was wrong.

pending_qa.q: What is Brian Koberger attempting to do after pleading guilty to the University of Idaho murders?
pending_qa.r: More than a year after Brian Koberger pleaded guilty to the 2022 killings of Kaylee Goncalves, Madison Mogen, Ethan Chapin, and Xana Kernodle, he filed a petition challenging his guilty plea and conviction, claiming innocence and alleging that his former attorneys provided ineffective assistance of counsel and coerced him into taking the plea. He is currently serving four life sentences.

pending_qa.q: What is the latest ruling in the Cori Richens murder case in Utah?
pending_qa.r: A judge denied a motion filed by Cori Richens's defense team seeking to disqualify trial judge Richard Mirzaic and grant her a new trial. The defense had alleged the judge was impatient, hostile, and condescending toward defense counsel while being friendly to the prosecution. Richens remains convicted of her husband Eric's murder, sentenced to life in prison without parole, and also faces separate 2025 charges including money laundering and mortgage fraud, with a next hearing scheduled for October 9th.
